''Broadcom BCM94360CSAX'' wireless module is used by some '''Apple''' devices. *[https://ru.ifixit.com/Teardown/MacBook+Pro+15-Inch+Retina+Display+Late+2013+Teardown/18696 ''Apple MacBook Pro 15" Retina Display (Late 2013) Teardown'' on '''iFixit'''] <small> :[[Broadcom]] BCM4360 - AirPort card (5GHz band, 1.3Gbps) :[[Broadcom]] BCM20702 - Single-chip Bluetooth 4.0 SoC :[[Skyworks]] SE5516 Dual-band 802.11abgn/ac WLAN FEM</small>
:There are some revisions with the new BCM20703A1 chip inside. :This chip supports Bluetooth 4.2
